name: work
description: Hook-based project lifecycle management — injects branch context on every prompt, reminds task updates on stop, manages worktrees (toggle via WORK_USE_WORKTREE), and guards force-operations (toggle via WORK_GUARD). Protected branches customizable via WORK_PROTECTED_BRANCHES (comma-separated, default master,main,develop). v2.47.0: branches are named `{type}/{title}` (no PR-number prefix); internal IDs continue in index.yaml for cross-reference only. Section names renamed: 関連PR → 関連ブランチ, 次PR候補 → 次ブランチ候補. v2.48.0: notes-to-claude skill removed (inter-plugin dependency eliminated). v2.49.0: drop NEXT_KIT_TS_CHECK / INJECTION_DISABLE entries from work:plugin-config (managed by /dev-kit:plugin-config or excluded by policy); migrate Step 2 to numbered list. v2.50.0: add WORK_BRANCH_AUTHOR env var to insert author name into branch names ({type}/{author}/{title}). v2.51.0: add WORK_COMMIT_LANG / WORK_COMMIT_TYPE env vars to configure commit message language and type prefix. v2.53.0: redefine notes as a current spec sheet (snapshot — present state only, no history in the body; change recorded only in a trailing 変更履歴 table; no YAML frontmatter); add ノート記述内容ルール reference injected on .work/notes/** edits; remove .work/specs (content merged into notes). v2.53.1: split references/ into category subfolders (notes/, work-dir/, skill-sync/). v2.54.0: index.yaml branch index is keyed by `branch` (drop id/last_id/tags); legacy backlog migrated to index.archive.yaml. v2.55.0: remove plugins/work/templates/ and setup-task.py — templates and per-folder structure definitions move into references/work-dir/ (タスクドキュメント / タスクインデックス / イシュー / ワークディレクトリ構成), injected by ref-inject when creating/editing the matching .work/ path (Write hook). work:start authors the branch document directly from the injected template. Branch document filename gains the .branch.md extension so the task folder can also hold user files. Rename ドットワークディレクトリ構成→ワークディレクトリ構成; remove TODOテンプレート同期. v2.56.0: redesign issue-scan as an orchestrator that delegates scanning to parallel work:issue-scanner subagents (new agent), scanning by perspective (folder/grep/layer/file-group/pattern) with ISSUE_SCAN_AGENTS setting the count; remove issue-save skill — the issue file format/numbering now lives in the work-dir/イシュー reference (auto-injected on .work/issues edits), authored directly by issue-create and issue-scanner. v2.57.0: task folder names are now Japanese ({YYMMDD}_{日本語タイトル}); existing 217 folders renamed in bulk, index.archive.yaml task: fields followed, and work:start / work-dir references updated to the Japanese-name convention. v2.59.0: remove setup-wizard skill and SessionStart hook (setup_check.py) from all plugins. v2.60.0: issue review/resolve workflow — ISSUE files gain frontmatter (decision/status/branches and a free-form instruction key) and QA moves onto the issue; add work:issue-review (mobile-first triage via AskUserQuestion), work:issue-resolve (loop-driven, one issue per tick: accept→issue-resolver subagent whose model is chosen by issue difficulty — sonnet/opus, never haiku; reject→shared chore/rejected-issues branch), and the work:issue-resolver agent; work:start links issues (status in_progress, branches, 関連イシュー); issue-tool.py gains set-status and close --linked-branch becomes an optional branch name; document the work lifecycle in CLAUDE.md. v2.61.0: add WORK_BASE_BRANCH env var to specify a base branch for new worktrees (git worktree add branches from this commit-ish when set). v2.62.0: revive work:conversation-to-claude (formerly claude-kit, removed in PR181) — analyzes the session and auto-generates artifacts (skill/rule/hook/CLAUDE.md/incidents/glossary), delegating skill/rule/hook/CLAUDE.md to claude-kit creator skills, with tightened glossary/incidents inclusion bars; add the PreCompact hook (pre-compact.py, toggle WORK_PRECOMPACT_CONV2CLAUDE) to run it before /compact, and restore the work:merge step that runs it inside the worktree (toggle WORK_MERGE_CONV2CLAUDE); add references/conversation/用語集.md + インシデント.md (glossary/incidents authoring guides) auto-injected via ref-inject on .claude/rules/glossary.md / .claude/rules/incidents.md / .claude/references/incidents/** edits. v2.63.0: redesign the ISSUE file format — drop YAML frontmatter; two-part Markdown layout (AI-authored top half + a # ユーザー回答欄 user-answer section with ## 意思 / ## QA / ## 自由記述, answer candidates pre-filled and 回答 left blank); rename ## 修正案 → ## 対応案 and drop the 問題点/詳細 section (背景/現状 cover it); move status/branches into _index.yaml only (issue-tool.py gains add-branch); update issue-create / issue-review / issue-resolve / issue-scan, the issue-scanner / issue-resolver agents, and work:start issue-linking accordingly. v2.64.0: rename the glossary authoring-guide reference to a Japanese filename 用語集.md (+ .jp.md); update injection_rules / _index / cross-links and pointers. v2.66.0: restore the work:plugin-config skill (interactive env toggle configuration for work plugin variables). v2.67.0: redesign the ISSUE user-answer section — move # ユーザー回答欄 (## 意思 / ## QA) to the top of the file so answered-state is visible without scrolling, with the AI-authored issue body below; each QA now carries a number, title, options, and an AI 推奨; drop the ## 自由記述 section (free-form notes go inline on the ## 意思 answer); replace the 回答候補/blank-回答 model — the AI pre-fills each **回答**: line with all candidates and the user narrows it to one; update issue-create / issue-review / issue-resolve / issue-scan, the issue-scanner / issue-resolver agents, and CLAUDE.md accordingly. v2.68.0: change issue-resolve's REJECT flow from accumulating on a shared chore/rejected-issues branch to closing each reject on a throwaway per-issue branch that is merged to master immediately within the same tick — keeping the main repo's gitignored _index.yaml (the source of truth) consistent with master every tick; the close runs in the main repo (not a worktree) so it updates _index.yaml directly, and the tracked move reaches master via the merge commit. v2.69.0: rename the task-document file extension .branch.md → .task.md (matches the tasks/ folder) and bulk-rename the 266 existing documents; rename the concept branch document → task document across current-spec references/skills/agents/hooks/CLAUDE.md (changelog history unchanged); v2.70.0: remove the work:quick-task skill and revert the UserPromptSubmit hook Step 3 to always run work:start. v2.71.0: move # ユーザー回答欄 to the bottom of the issue file (after ---, following the AI-authored body); update イシュー.md template, issue-create / issue-review / issue-resolve, the issue-scanner agent, and CLAUDE.md accordingly. v2.72.0: add ISSUE_RESOLVE_AGENTS env var (default 1) — maximum actionable issues processed per issue-resolve invocation, handled sequentially in ascending issue-number order. v2.73.0: add direct_merge parameter to issue-resolver (default true) — when true the resolver merges the branch to master directly after the final commit and closes the issue; issue-resolve determines the value from _index.yaml or by analyzing issue content (UI-related→false, refactor/test/backend→true); issue-scan sets direct_merge: true in _index.yaml for single-solution non-UI issues; document WORK_GUARD=false as the way to skip the merge-guard prompt during automated direct merges.
